newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News says Ansett trading difficult.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News says Ansett trading difficult.

text.p: The News Corp Ltd said on Tuesday its 50 percent owned airline Ansett Holdings Ltd continued to experience difficult trading conditions in both the domestic and international markets in the three months to September.
"A small increase in passenger numbers was offset by reduced load factors due to strong competition on the main trunk routes," News Corp said in a statement accompanying its first quarter results.
Air New Zealand's acquisition of TNT Ltd's 50 percent stake in Ansett Australia was completed on October 1, as was a A$200 million capital injection, with News Corporation contributing A$50 million.
News Corp said Ansett International results were lower due to start up services to Indonesia, Korea and Taiwan and increased competition on the Japan route.
News Corp did not provide any separate results for Ansett.
